safety: K1: scratch under /var/tmp only; witness-only ssh/pm2 shims first on PATH; fake LLM gated on `command -v ssh pm2`; loopback fake model only; scratch removed.

1.fact: Plugins load (~9 s after spawn, fresh data dir) while stdin is still open and unread; the plugin init is awaited (hello held 2-3 s, nothing else happened); the first LLM request comes only after the prompt is written to stdin. With the prompt withheld: no plugin, OPENCODE_PURE=1, --pure, a throwing sole plugin, or a hello never accepted all give zero LLM requests until the kill (15 s).

2.fact: fd 3 (socketpair) is a duplex via net.connect({fd:3}) or fs streams; `new net.Socket({fd:3})` closes at once under Bun 1.4.4 (the dsh plugin pattern does NOT carry over). fd 3 is O_CLOEXEC in opencode (fdinfo flags 02004002); bash children hold only fds 0-2.

3.fact: tool.execute.before fires for bash/read/edit/glob/grep/todowrite/webfetch/skill/task/invalid/apply_patch, MCP tools (<server>_<tool>), list_mcp_resources, read_mcp_resource, and inside task child sessions. Throwing stops the body (error text reaches the model). A 65 s await does not abort the call.

4.fact: Registry under `run` with a non-gpt model: bash, edit, glob, grep, read, skill, task, todowrite, webfetch, write (question/plan_* denied by run; websearch only with exa/parallel). A gpt-* model (not oss/gpt-4) gets apply_patch instead of edit+write. bash has `workdir`. MCP resource tools: list_mcp_resources, list_mcp_resource_templates, read_mcp_resource. Unknown tool or unparseable args become tool `invalid` (hook fires with {tool,error}; body only returns an error). Relative paths resolve against cwd; `~/x` is NOT expanded (becomes <cwd>/~/x). Extra unknown fields are tolerated by glob/grep/todowrite (no strict schema). Schemas: llm request tools[] in the scenarios.

5.fact: tool.execute.after: input {tool,sessionID,callID,args}, output {title,output,metadata,attachments}; appending to output.output reaches stdout and the model. shell.env fires per bash call with input {callID,cwd,sessionID}; output.env holds additions only: `delete` does NOT remove an inherited variable, assigning `undefined` does.

6.fact: stdout state.input is the args object the body ran with (post-hook, in-place mutations visible). Reassigning output.args is ignored by the body, but a later hook sees the reassigned object: a plugin ordered BEFORE ours can show us a decoy while the body runs an in-place-mutated original. Hooks run in plugin-array order. Deep-freezing output.args (and locking the property) makes a later plugin's mutation throw; bash/read/edit/glob/grep/todowrite/task/bash+workdir all run correctly on frozen args.

7.fact: callID is the provider tool_call id verbatim. A local server that repeats an id gets the SAME callID twice in ONE session (both calls ran), and again in a second session. Keying by sessionID+callID with "repeat = deny" would refuse the second legitimate call.

8.fact: OPENCODE_PERMISSION {"*":"allow"} lets external_directory and 4 identical calls (doom_loop) through; without it external_directory is auto-rejected (after tool.execute.before already fired). Agent-level permission `bash: deny` removes bash from the tool list even with the env allow (agent > env). Config-level `permission.bash` deny pattern was overridden by the env allow (env > config).

9.fact: stdout tool_use callID equals the hook callID. Subagent (task child session) parts do NOT appear on stdout: only the parent task part does, so an undecided-result check on stdout cannot see subagent calls.

10.fact: A project opencode.json formatter runs after edit and its LSP server is spawned on read (and delays the turn ~45 s). Inline OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT lsp:false + formatter:false wins over the project opencode.json: neither runs. Env flags in 1.19.5: OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL{,_BACKGROUND_SUBAGENTS,_BASH_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS,_CODE_MODE,_DISABLE_COPY_ON_SELECT,_DISABLE_FILEWATCHER,_EVENT_SYSTEM,_EXA,_FILEWATCHER,_ICON_DISCOVERY,_LSP_TOOL,_LSP_TY,_NATIVE_LLM,_OUTPUT_TOKEN_MAX,_OXFMT,_PARALLEL,_PLAN_MODE,_REFERENCES,_WEBSOCKETS,_WORKSPACES}, OPENCODE_ENABLE_{EXA,EXPERIMENTAL_MODELS,PARALLEL,QUESTION_TOOL}. Per-variable effect of stripping: not measured (INCONCLUSIVE part).

11.fact: A stdin prompt starting with `!` or `/init` reaches the model as plain text; no shell ran (witness absent), no command expansion.

12.fact: `--agent plan` exists (edit refused by its rule). `debug agent build` loads plugins (hello received). The file:// plugin entry in OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT loads; plugins and their hooks run in array order; a plugin that throws at load is skipped and the rest still load.

13.fact: Live Claude measurement of dontAsk/auto needs real Claude turns, excluded from this stage by the K1 instruction (local fake LLM only). Rows stay assumptions (M10).

qa.pathShims: PROVEN: OpenCode bash runs `/bin/bash -c` (opts hBc: non-login, non-interactive; rc files not sourced) in its own session (pid=pgid=sid); with the operator .bashrc/.profile copied into HOME, PATH stayed shim-first.
qa.deepFreeze: PROVEN safe for bash, read, edit, glob, grep, todowrite, task (see item 6).
qa.inlineVsProject: PROVEN: inline lsp:false/formatter:false beat the project opencode.json (item 10).
